title.narrative: Support for the Family Farming, Resilience and Markets Project in Upper and Middle Guinea (AgriFARM)

description.narrative: To improve access to markets and improve small farmers and rural populations access to markets, The “AgriFarm” project, financed by IFAD, the Arab Bank for Development in Africa, calls upon UNOPS for the implementation of a part of the hydro-agricultural facilities project management and infrastructure needs in Guinea. The project scope additionally includes rural road rehabilitation and procurement services.\n
